#!/bin/sh
# mmu_w10s_run.rcS — self-contained W10S (PTW store variant, M06 R02 / M08 R05).
#
# Runtime-VA contract (the Excel WorkloadID stays W10):
#   M06 R02  W10S-COLD-STORE  --cold --target-va 0x4001100000
#   M08 R05  W10S-WARM-STORE  --warm --target-va 0x4001400000
#   neighbor VA = target VA + W10S_NEIGH_DELTA (0x200000)
#   buffer VA   = 0x4002000000 (default; --buffer-va override)
#
# This BASE template runs BOTH variants.  Formal per-sample runs must select
# exactly one:
#   configs/fs/generated/mmu_w10s_run_M06_R02.rcS   (--cold 0x4001100000)
#   configs/fs/generated/mmu_w10s_run_M08_R05.rcS   (--warm 0x4001400000)
# The W10S_VARIANT marker blocks below let Main derive a scoped copy.
#
# Buffer placement: the guest rootfs (/var/tmp/w10s, ext4) is preferred over
# tmpfs.  Measured natively: tmpfs-backed page-cache allocation can fail to
# produce an XOR1 PFN pair even at the 65536-page cap; ext4-backed files do.
ulimit -l unlimited 2>/dev/null || true
echo "[mmu-w10s] install"
base64 -d > /tmp/mmu-w10s.gz <<'MMU_W10S_B64'
